tools.name: scan_figma_prototype
tools.description: Scan a Figma file for prototype navigation issues: dead-end screens, orphan screens, missing back navigation, undersized touch targets, overlapping hotspots, missing scroll, and overlay traps. Optionally compute a 0-100 usability score grounded in peer-reviewed HCI science (WCAG contrast, Hick–Hyman, Miller, Fitts, readability, Gestalt, Von Restorff). Optionally run a headless browser simulator to verify clicks actually navigate. Returns a detailed report. If the client supports MCP Apps, renders an interactive HTML report inline.

file_key.description: Figma file key or full URL (e.g. "abc123" or "https://figma.com/design/abc123/Name?node-id=7-2")

token.description: Figma Personal Access Token. Falls back to FIGMA_TOKEN env var.

simulate.description: Run headless browser simulator to verify prototype navigation actually works. Slower (~2 min) but catches runtime issues static analysis misses.

score.description: Compute the 0-100 usability score (ProtoScan Science) with a per-dimension breakdown and top fixes. Implies metrics.

metrics.description: Run the science metric analyzers without the aggregate score.

ergonomics.description: Alias for score — emphasises the per-dimension usability breakdown. Implies metrics.

min_touch_target.description: Minimum touch target size in px

skip.description: Checks to skip: dead-end, orphan, back-nav, touch-target, overlap, scroll, overlay-trap, contrast, cognitive-load, fitts, typography, readability, gestalt, emphasis, balance

ignore.description: Screen-name globs to exclude from the whole scan, e.g. ["* — Dev", "* — Demo", "[FIX]*"] (only * is a wildcard).
